title: Database multiple-choice assignment with guided GPT-3 support
summary: Third-year database students solve multiple-choice problems about topics including transaction serializability while using a GPT-3 tutor that withholds explicit answers and SQL. Randomized variants provide combinations of suggestions, examples, metacognitive questions, and a solve-then-refine protocol before the same assignment.
